## Better donor experiences drive more revenue

Convert more supporters with AI-powered fundraising experiences built for every giving moment.

### AI at Fundraise Up

AI is reshaping the ways donors give. Fundraise Up uses AI to create better donor experiences that drive more impact.

[Explore AI Overview](https://fundraiseup.com/ai/)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 696 480'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![](https://max.ucarecdn.com/9c6753c3-e49b-4174-b20b-cacc2ca3f14a/-/preview/128x128/-/format/auto/-/quality/lighter/-/blur/25/)![](https://max.ucarecdn.com/9c6753c3-e49b-4174-b20b-cacc2ca3f14a/-/format/auto/-/quality/lighter/-/resize/1392x/)

### Checkout

Faster, smarter, and optimized for higher conversion, Checkout increases revenue and improves the donor experience.

[Explore Checkout](https://fundraiseup.com/features/checkout/)

### Gift Cart

Donors shouldn’t have to choose just one cause to support. Gift Cart brings it all into a single checkout. More choices. More giving. Less friction.

[Explore Gift Cart](https://fundraiseup.com/features/gift-cart/)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 592 340'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![](https://a.storyblok.com/f/285823045102956/1184x680/86bbf92341/homepage-gift-cart.png/m/150x150/filters:quality(60):blur(24))![](https://a.storyblok.com/f/285823045102956/1184x680/86bbf92341/homepage-gift-cart.png/m/1184x680/filters:format(png):quality(60))

Accept donations from cards, digital wallets, bank transfers, and non-cash payment methods.

[Explore Payment methods](https://fundraiseup.com/platform/payment-methods/)

## Keep donor data safe

Safeguard your donor experience with Fundraise Up’s security and anti-fraud features.

### Security

Protect your nonprofit, donors, and data with comprehensive security tools and compliances.

[Explore Security](https://fundraiseup.com/platform/security/)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 592 340'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![](https://a.storyblok.com/f/285823045102956/1184x680/a54147f4fd/homepage-security.png/m/150x150/filters:quality(60):blur(24))![](https://a.storyblok.com/f/285823045102956/1184x680/a54147f4fd/homepage-security.png/m/1184x680/filters:format(png):quality(60))

[Explore Fraud protection](https://fundraiseup.com/platform/fraud-protection/)

[Explore Compliances](https://fundraiseup.com/platform/compliances/)
